title: Lease recovery after holder death (and fencing)
armsNotExecuted: distributed/NFS fencing (G-13, v2 scope; excluded by Q-08)
limitations: An initial counter-equality rerun returned 8750/10000 because one writer died to a concurrent CREATE-TABLE-IF-NOT-EXISTS race at startup (a harness bug, NOT a mutual-exclusion failure). The harness was hardened to pre-initialize the schema once before spawning writers; the corrected rerun reached 10000/10000. Filesystem tmpfs (local-kernel OFD). G-13 (revocation-proof fence) remains a v2-only gap; the classifier arm proves the decision logic, not an atomic distributed primitive.
